🧭 Local travel essentials
Getting around
MRT (north–south), LRT, KRL Commuterline (commuter rail), TransJakarta (BRT express bus) + ride-hailing. Load prepaid bank card (or operator card) onto transit tap card. Park Ji-hoon fan con (2026-08-29, final stop) venue unannounced as of 6/6 (TBA)—major Jakarta venues: Gelora Bung Karno (GBK, central, near MRT Istora Mandiri station), JIExpo Kemayoran, ICE BSD (outlying Tangerang, KRL/shuttle). Reconfirm routes when announced.
See more
Late-night transit
MRT/LRT last trains ~midnight (00:00; varies by station/direction; events may extend to ~01:30). TransJakarta main lines end ~23:00 (some 7 routes run 24hr). Concert end may overrun—Gojek, Grab ride-hailing standard. For outlying venues like ICE BSD, check last-train/KRL times ahead + call early after curtain.
Payment
Large malls, hotels, and chains accept cards readily. Street vendors and traditional markets run cash-first. QRIS (Indonesia's unified QR payment system) works widely from cafes to markets—GoPay, OVO, DANA, and other e-wallets process via single QR (some e-wallets support international card signup for foreign visitors). Keep small rupiah on you at all times.
Currency & exchange
Indonesian Rupiah (IDR, Rp). Units are large—thousands are common—so verify denominations. Keep small bills for street vendors and markets. Exchange booths and ATMs throughout the airport and city. Cash use declining as QRIS spreads.
Language
Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia). English at tourist sites and transit is good; everyday English, less so. Translation and service apps help. Locals welcome basic phrases like 'Terima kasih (thank you)' and 'Berapa? (How much?)' for getting what you need.
Local apps
Gojek (Rides, bikes, food, GoPay payments—super-app, local #1) · Grab (Backup app for rides and bikes (compare fares, spread the load)) · Google Maps (MRT, KRL, and TransJakarta routes)
Late-night transit
Gojek (Late-night rides (GoCar) and bikes (GoRide): go-to choice with GoPay prepayment (top market share)) · Grab (Backup for rides and bikes—if Gojek doesn't respond, try Grab (sometimes cheaper on longer routes)) · Blue Bird (My Bluebird) (Official Blue Bird taxi app—metered, trusted cabs on demand (late-night fallback))  📶 eSIM ↗
How to book
Book away from the venue entrance. Gojek not responding? Try Grab or Blue Bird to spread demand. For outlying venues (ICE BSD, etc.), request before the show ends—or use KRL's last train.
